The '''Onderia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] regions.<ref name="Trailing Sectors" /> The system shared its name with the [[720 light freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Onderian Raptor]]''.<ref name="Murder">"[[Murder on the Executor|Murder on the ''Executor'']]"</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Onderia system was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system in grid square M-13.<ref name="EAOC" />
